Best imports
Spread = sell price − buy price (₨/kg, avg over window).   Truck/kg = distance × rate set by the 🚛 Vehicle selector above (PKR/100kg).   Net/kg = Spread − Truck cost.   Max viable km = Spread ÷ truck rate — how far you could go before profit hits zero. Higher = safer trade.   Consistent = % of days in window where both cities had prices AND the spread beat truck cost — only counts days with matching data on both sides, so stale cities (shown as Xd old) may have fewer matching days than fresh ones.   Click column headers to sort.
All fuel/cost inputs optional. Distance auto-fills. Optimize ranks best outbound + return combo.
